en.expert: Large MCP/Composio outputs move behind a bounded preview and line-paginated retrieval URI. Original content remains in history and events; reducing what the model receives does not mean replacing the original with the preview.

en.expert: Retrieval is bounded by a volatile, session-scoped cache: 16 MiB maximum and expiry after five unread iterations. Neither the pointer nor history retention proves that this same retrieval route survives eviction or process restart.
en.kitchen: The reading copy sits in a size-limited drawer for the current service. Five rounds without consulting it end its stay, so the reference is not a promise that the drawer will remain available forever.
